title: Design System: Sean Rizarre Reyes · Prism Bench

themes.mechanism: `.dark` class on <html>, set before paint from localStorage (anything but 'light' = dark)
themes.note: Tokens without -light suffix are dark-mode values; -light / daylight / ink-light keys are the light-mode redefinitions of the same CSS variables.

alphaTokens.name: --line-strong
alphaTokens.purpose: Chip, input and outline-button strokes; scrollbar thumb.

alphaTokens.name: --hole-lit
alphaTokens.purpose: Breadboard hole inside the 220px cursor light.

display.purpose: Hero name and the Contact close only; spreads from wdth 62 on load.

headline.purpose: Section titles, company name, GWA figure; followed by a band hairline wipe.

quote.purpose: Recommendation pull quotes and the contact email.

title.purpose: Skill row, project and degree titles.

label.purpose: Mono readouts: θ, dates, band tags, scale ticks, tech chips.

shadows.purpose: Every glass surface at rest, dark mode.

shadows.name: glass-ambient-light
shadows.purpose: Every glass surface at rest, light mode.

shadows.name: chip-glow

shadows.name: line-glow

effects.name: dispersed-edge
effects.value: 1px masked border: radial-gradient(260px circle at --mx --my, beam 0, api 12%, data 24%, ai 36%, lab 46%, transparent 62%); opacity 0 → 1 over 400ms on hover

effects.name: caustic
effects.value: radial-gradient(380px circle at --mx --my, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06 dark | 0.7 light), transparent 60%)
effects.purpose: Interior light following the cursor inside glass.

effects.value: radial-gradient holes, 28px pitch, 14px offset; lit layer masked to a 220px circle at --cx/--cy
effects.purpose: Fixed optical breadboard behind the page.

effects.name: light-pool
effects.purpose: Floating orbs where the spectrum lands.

motion.name: spread
motion.purpose: Hero name entrance; second line delayed 120ms.

motion.name: reveal-heading
motion.value: 0.9s; opacity 0.25 → 1, y 24px → 0, blur 6px → 0; hairline scaleX 0 → 1 over 1.4s at +0.25s

motion.name: reveal-row
motion.purpose: Skill rows sliding in from the left.

motion.name: magnetic-shell
motion.value: spring stiffness 160, damping 14, mass 0.7; strength 0.42 within 110px
motion.purpose: CTA and avatar pull toward the cursor.

motion.name: nav-band
motion.purpose: Active underline moving between nav links.

motion.name: beam-follow
motion.value: aim += (target - aim) * 0.07 per frame; touch: sin(t/2600) * 0.6

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all keyframes off; beam draws once; GWA jumps to final; smooth scroll off

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action (Get in Touch, View Resume): ink fill, shine sweep, spectrum underline and AI Cyan glow on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 56px; padding: 0 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 26px; background: var(--ink, #f5f7fa); color: var(--ground, #07080d); font: 600 15px Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 300ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 10px 40px -8px var(--s-ai, #33c2ff); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--s-ai, #33c2ff); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary .ds-shine { position: absolute; inset: 0; transform: translateX(-100%); background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.3), transparent); transition: transform 700ms; pointer-events: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-shine { transform: translateX(100%); } .ds-btn-primary .ds-under { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 3px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--s-ui, #ff5a36), var(--s-api, #ffb020), var(--s-data, #2de2a6), var(--s-ai, #33c2ff), var(--s-cloud, #5b85ff), var(--s-lab, #a585ff)); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 500ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-under { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-btn-primary svg { transition: transform 300ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover svg { transform: rotate(-12deg) scale(1.1); }

components.name: Glass Button
components.description: Secondary contact paths (GitHub, LinkedIn): frosted glass with a strong hairline that turns ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-glass { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 54px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 26px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgb(245 247 250 / 0.18)); background: var(--glass-bg, rgb(20 23 32 / 0.5)); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); color: var(--ink, #f5f7fa); font: 500 15px Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 300ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-glass:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #f5f7fa); } .ds-btn-glass:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-glass:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--s-ai, #33c2ff); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-glass .ds-shine { position: absolute; inset: 0; transform: translateX(-100%); background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.2), transparent); transition: transform 700ms; pointer-events: none; } .ds-btn-glass:hover .ds-shine { transform: translateX(100%); } .ds-btn-glass svg { transition: transform 300ms; } .ds-btn-glass:hover svg { transform: rotate(12deg) scale(1.1); }

components.name: Pill Action
components.description: Small outline pill (Resume, Copy email, chat actions) that fills with ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-pill-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgb(245 247 250 / 0.18)); background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2, #c3c9d4); font: 500 14px Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms, background 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-pill-action:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #f5f7fa); background: var(--ink, #f5f7fa); color: var(--ground, #07080d); } .ds-pill-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--s-ai, #33c2ff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Skill Chip
components.description: Skill pill inside a band row; on hover it lifts and takes the row's band as border and glow.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-chip { padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgb(245 247 250 / 0.18)); background: rgb(7 8 13 / 0.4); color: var(--ink-2, #c3c9d4); font: 400 14px Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: all 300ms; } .ds-chip:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--band); color: var(--ink, #f5f7fa); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px -6px var(--band); }

components.css: .ds-glass { position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 40px; border-radius: 1.5rem; color: var(--ink, #f5f7fa); background: var(--glass-bg, rgb(20 23 32 / 0.5)); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(160%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(160%); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border, rgb(245 247 250 / 0.1)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-highlight, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07)), 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4), 0 18px 40px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6); } .ds-glass .ds-edge { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--band) 30%, var(--band) 70%, transparent); } .ds-glass-title { margin: 0; font: 700 1.8rem/1.2 Archivo, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-glass-body { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--ink-2, #c3c9d4); font: 400 1rem/1.625 Geist, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; }

components.html: APIBackend & APIs
components.css: .ds-band-row { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 16px; padding: 20px 28px; border-radius: 1rem; color: var(--ink, #f5f7fa); background: var(--glass-bg, rgb(20 23 32 / 0.5)); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(160%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(160%); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border, rgb(245 247 250 / 0.1)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-highlight, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07)), 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4), 0 18px 40px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6); } .ds-band-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0.13; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--band), transparent 55%); transition: opacity 500ms; pointer-events: none; } .ds-band-row:hover .ds-band-fill { opacity: 0.25; } .ds-band-tag { position: relative; width: 48px; color: var(--band); font: 600 11px 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-band-title { position: relative; font: 700 1.25rem Archivo, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }

components.css: .ds-nav-wrap { position: relative; padding-top: 12px; } .ds-progress { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 40%; height: 3px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--s-ui, #ff5a36) 0 16.66%, var(--s-api, #ffb020) 0 33.33%, var(--s-data, #2de2a6) 0 50%, var(--s-ai, #33c2ff) 0 66.66%, var(--s-cloud, #5b85ff) 0 83.33%, var(--s-lab, #a585ff) 0 100%); } .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; color: var(--ink-3, #8a93a3); font: 400 14px Geist, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--ink, #f5f7fa); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--s-ai, #33c2ff); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-link.ds-active { color: var(--ink, #f5f7fa); } .ds-nav-link.ds-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 12px; right: 12px; bottom: -2px; height: 2px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--band); box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--band); }

components.name: Display Name
components.description: The one loud thing: extra-wide Archivo that spreads from narrow and light to wide and heavy on load.
components.css: @keyframes ds-spread { from { font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 62; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: 0.04em; opacity: 0; filter: blur(10px); } to { font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 125; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.025em; opacity: 1; filter: blur(0); } } .ds-display { margin: 0; color: var(--ink, #f5f7fa); font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 8.6vw, 6rem); font-weight: 800; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 125; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 0.92; } .ds-display span { display: block; animation: ds-spread 1.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } .ds-display span + span { animation-delay: 120ms; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-display span { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The page is an optical bench in a dark lab. The ground is near-black and drilled with a breadboard grid of tapped holes that brighten around the cursor. One white beam enters from the left edge, passes through a cut-glass prism holding Sean's photo, and leaves as a six-band spectrum. Each band is one layer of the stack he ships: UI, API, DATA, AI, CLOUD, LAB. From there the spectrum runs through the rest of the page. Every section, nav link, skill row, rail dot and recommender owns one band. At Contact the bands come back together into a single beam.

Dark is the default and the home of the system: the lab with the lights off. Light mode is the same bench in daylight. Its grounds are cool paper, its ink is near-black and the bands are deepened versions of the same six hues. Surfaces are frosted cut glass, not cards on a page. Under the cursor, a glass panel's edge splits into spectrum, the same thing the prism does to the beam. The single loud element is the name, set in an extra-wide grotesk. Everything else is quieter and leaves room for the light.

The motion grammar is light travelling: wipes run in the direction of travel, ease-outs are exponential, and everything is readable before it animates. With reduced motion on, the page shows the static split. The build rejects the generic dev-portfolio look: a centered avatar, gradient-filled text, and blue-purple glass as the brand.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first near-black bench (#07080d) with a 28px breadboard hole grid lit around the cursor
One white beam and a six-band hard-stop spectrum that encodes skill layers wherever it appears
Frosted cut-glass panels whose edges split into spectrum under the cursor
Extra-wide Archivo (wdth 125, weight 800) for display, Geist for reading, Geist Mono only for readouts
Magnetic, morphing controls whose corners sharpen toward the cursor
Light reveals: clip and scale wipes in the direction of travel, ease-out cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)

rules.name: The Band Means Layer Rule
rules.body: A band color is never decorative. It always points to its layer (UI, API, DATA, AI, CLOUD, LAB) or to the section that owns it. Do not add a seventh hue. White is the beam, not a band.

rules.name: The Spectrum Order Rule
rules.body: Wherever several bands appear together (progress bar, dots, wordmark, rails, the Contact recombination), they run UI → API → DATA → AI → CLOUD → LAB, short to long wavelength.

rules.name: The Dark Is Home Rule
rules.body: Tokens are designed dark-first. Light mode redefines the same names; it never adds new roles.

rules.name: The One Loud Thing Rule
rules.body: Only the name, the section titles and the close use the wdth-125 display voice. Everything else uses Archivo at normal width or Geist.

rules.name: The Mono Is Measurement Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is for values, readouts and data tags. Never use it for prose or headings.

rules.name: The Left-Origin Rule
rules.body: Light enters from the left. Section titles, beams, band wipes and skill-row fills all start at the left and travel right (origin-left). Headings never center.

rules.name: The Light Pools Rule
rules.body: The floating blurred orbs (blur 90px, opacity 0.22 in light and 0.16 in dark) represent spectrum landing on the bench. Each one takes the color of a band, never an off-system hue, and they drift slowly (9s / 14s) behind content.

rules.name: The Dispersed Edge Rule
rules.body: Interactive glass carries `data-spot`. Under the cursor, its 1px border turns into a radial spectrum (beam → amber → green → cyan → violet) and a faint caustic lights its interior. This is the system's hover language for surfaces.

dos: **Do** tie every band color to its layer or owning section, and keep the order UI → API → DATA → AI → CLOUD → LAB wherever bands appear together.

**Do** build surfaces from the glass recipe (glass fill, 18px blur at 160% saturation, 1px glass border, inset highlight, ambient shadow) and mark interactive ones with `data-spot` so their edge disperses.

**Do** start reveals from the left, in the direction light travels, using cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). Scroll reveals start at 25–40% opacity so content is readable before it animates. Only the hero's load entrance (name spread, claim, prism, chat, done within about 1.5s) starts from 0.
**Do** keep wdth 125 for the name, section titles and the close. Everything else uses Archivo at wdth 100 or Geist.
**Do** use Geist Mono with tabular figures for readouts, dates and data tags.
**Do** give every effect a reduced-motion path that shows the finished static state.
**Do** keep small text at 4.5:1 or better against its ground in both themes.
donts: **Don't** use gradient-filled text. Spectrum appears as lines, bars, edges, fills and light, never inside letterforms.
**Don't** let blue and violet carry the brand alone. They are two bands of six, and a blue-purple glass portfolio is the explicit anti-reference.
**Don't** center the hero around the avatar. The name leads from the top-left, and the photo lives inside the prism.
**Don't** add hues outside the bench neutrals, the beam and the six bands.
**Don't** use hard offset shadows. Depth is translucency, ambient shadow and band glow.
